'''Sammul Sharsha''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] and one of the most trusted advisors of [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]] in the [[Circle of Lords]]. Sharsha assumed the position after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Sammul Sharsha's husband|husband]].
